title: Nepal pushes Tibet conference online amid reports of Chinese pressure - Firstpost
description: Nepal pushes Tibet conference online amid reports of Chinese pressure  Firstpost
publisher.title: Firstpost
full_article:
An international conference on Tibet scheduled to be held in Nepal has been moved online after Kathmandu University withdrew as its host, triggering questions over whether pressure from China influenced the decision.

The International Association for Tibetan Studies (IATS) conference was scheduled for August 23-29 and had been in preparation for around four years. It was expected to bring scholars from across the world to Kathmandu to discuss Tibetan history, language, culture, religion, art and society.

Nepal's government has denied ordering the cancellation, saying the organisers decided on their own to move the event online. However, officials cited by The Kathmandu Post said senior government officials intervened after concerns were raised by China, while Nepal's security agencies had not recommended cancelling the conference.

Advertisement

What happened to the Tibet conference?

Kathmandu University had been preparing to convene the conference but was asked to withdraw from hosting it, according to organisers. The university subsequently stepped back, leaving IATS to decide whether the event would continue online and whether another venue could be found.

Nepal's Chief Secretary Govinda Bahadur Karkee acknowledged that the government had discussed the conference with university officials. He said authorities advised organisers that holding the event could create sensitivities and security concerns.

However, the head of a security agency told AFP that officials had examined the conference from several angles but had not recommended cancelling it. The plan was instead to continue monitoring the event.

More from World

The reported intervention also came shortly after Home Minister Sudan Gurung had publicly indicated that the conference would not be cancelled and that participants would instead undergo security checks.

China pressure enters the picture

The reversal has fuelled speculation about China's role. According to officials cited by the Post , Chinese diplomatic efforts intensified after registration for the conference closed in June.

Chinese Ambassador Zhang Maoming met Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai on July 21 to discuss the conference. Officials familiar with the meeting said the ambassador did not directly demand cancellation but raised concerns about participants who could make statements supporting Tibet.

A Chinese religious figure and political adviser, Venerable Master Yinshun, also visited Nepal on July 29 and reportedly discussed the conference during his trip.

Advertisement

The developments were followed by the withdrawal of several Tibetan experts from the Tibetan Policy Institute in India.

One Nepalese official cited by the Post said the conference had effectively become a test of Kathmandu's balancing act between China and the West, with the government choosing to ease Beijing's concerns.

Organisers reject China-related concerns

Organisers have argued that the conference was an academic event rather than a political gathering. They said Nepal had been selected to host it in 2022 and that around 100 Chinese scholars and experts were also expected to attend.

Participants from Chinese institutions, including Peking University and the China Tibetology Research Centre, had registered for the event. Organisers also said they had assured Nepalese authorities that the conference would not be used for pro-Tibet or anti-China activism.

IATS, founded at the University of Oxford in 1979, describes itself as an organisation without political affiliation.

The dispute comes at a sensitive time. Nepal hosts thousands of Tibetan refugees and has longstanding cultural and religious links with Tibet, while China is its second-largest trading partner after India.

Advertisement

Nepal's delicate balancing act

The conference controversy highlights the difficult position Nepal occupies between its two large neighbours.

China has consistently opposed international activities it views as challenging its sovereignty over Tibet. Nepal, meanwhile, has sought to maintain close economic and political ties with Beijing while managing its relationship with India and Western countries.

The issue has gained further sensitivity following protests by Tibetans against China's new Ethnic Unity Law, which came into effect on July 1.

Despite the conference being moved online, a Chinese delegation linked to the event is still expected to visit Nepal later this month. A five-member delegation led by Chinese political figure Jiang Jianguo is scheduled to arrive on August 18 for a three-day visit.

The Chinese Embassy in Kathmandu has not publicly responded to questions about its alleged role in the conference decision.

नेपालमे होबय बला तिब्बत विषयमे आयोजित अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्मेलनके काठमाण्डौ विश्वविद्यालयके मेजबानीके रुपमे हटलाके बाद ऑनलाइन स्थानान्तरित कएल गेल अछि, जाहिसँ चीनके दबाव निर्णयके प्रभावित भेल कि नै, एहि पर सवाल उठल अछि ।

इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन फॉर तिब्बती अध्ययन (आईएटीएस) केरऽ सम्मेलन 23-29 अगस्त क॑ होलऽ छेलै आरू लगभग चार साल स॑ एकरऽ तैयारी म॑ छै । उम्मीद छल जे दुनिया भरिक विद्वान कए काठमांडू आनि कए तिब्बती इतिहास, भाषा, संस्कृति, धर्म, कला आ समाज पर चर्चा कैल जाएत।

नेपाल सरकार रद्द करबाक आदेश देबा सँ इनकार करैत कहलक अछि जे आयोजक लोकनि अपनहि सँ आयोजन केँ ऑनलाइन करबाक निर्णय लेलनि। लेकिन द काठमांडू पोस्ट के हवाला स॑ अधिकारी सिनी के कहना छै कि चीन द्वारा चिंता व्यक्त करला के बाद सरकारी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी हस्तक्षेप करलकै, जबकि नेपाल के सुरक्षा एजेंसी न॑ सम्मेलन रद्द करै के सिफारिश नै करलकै ।

विज्ञापन

तिब्बत सम्मेलन के की भेल?

काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय सम्मेलन के आह्वान करै के तैयारी में छेलै, लेकिन ओकरा आयोजन करै स॑ हटै लेली कहलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, आयोजकऽ के अनुसार । एकरऽ बाद विश्वविद्यालय पीछे हटी गेलै, जेकरा चलतें आईएटीएस क॑ ई तय करै के मौका मिललै कि ई आयोजन ऑनलाइन जारी रहतै कि नै आरू दोसरऽ जगह मिल॑ सकै छै कि नै ।

नेपालके मुख्य सचिव गोविन्दबहादुर कार्की सरकार विश्वविद्यालयके अधिकारीसबसब सम्मेलनके विषयमे विमर्श कएलगेल स्वीकार केलन्हि । ओ कहलनि जे, अधिकारी आयोजक के सलाह देलनि जे आयोजन के आयोजन सं संवेदनशीलता आ सुरक्षा के चिंता पैदा भ सकैत अछि।

लेकिन सुरक्षा एजेंसी के प्रमुख न॑ एएफपी क॑ बतैलकै कि अधिकारी न॑ सम्मेलन केरऽ कई कोण स॑ जांच करलकै लेकिन एकरा रद्द करै के सिफारिश नै करलकै । योजना एकर बदला मे एहि आयोजन क निगरानी जारी रखबाक छल।

विश्व से अधिक

गृहमंत्री सूडान गुरुंग केरऽ सार्वजनिक तौर प॑ ई संकेत देला के कुछ देर बाद भी करलऽ गेलऽ हस्तक्षेप के सूचना देलऽ गेलऽ छै कि ई सम्मेलन रद्द नै करलऽ जैतै आरू एकरऽ बदला म॑ प्रतिभागी सिनी के सुरक्षा जांच करलऽ जैतै ।

चीन के दबाव तस्वीर में प्रवेश करैत अछि

एहि उलटफेर स चीन क भूमिका पर अटकलबाजी बढ़ि गेल अछि। पोस्ट द्वारा उद्धृत अधिकारी के अनुसार जून में सम्मेलन के लेल पंजीकरण बंद भेला के बाद चीनी कूटनीतिक प्रयास तेज भ गेल।

चीन के राजदूत झांग माओमिंग 21 जुलाई के विदेश सचिव अमृत बहादुर राय सं भेंट क सम्मेलन पर चर्चा केलनि। बैठक स॑ परिचित अधिकारी सिनी न॑ कहलकै कि राजदूत न॑ सीधा तौर प॑ रद्द करै के मांग नै करलकै लेकिन प्रतिभागी सिनी के बारे म॑ चिंता जतैलकै जे तिब्बत के समर्थन करै वाला बयान द॑ सकै छै ।

चीन केरऽ एगो धार्मिक हस्ती आरू राजनीतिक सलाहकार पूज्य मास्टर यिनशुन भी २९ जुलाई क॑ नेपाल गेलऽ छेलै आरू अपनऽ यात्रा के दौरान सम्मेलन के बारे म॑ चर्चा करै के खबर छै ।

विज्ञापन

एहि घटनाक्रम क बाद भारत मे तिब्बती नीति संस्थान स कईटा तिब्बती विशेषज्ञ क वापसी भेल।

पोस्ट केरऽ हवाला स॑ एगो नेपाली अधिकारी न॑ कहलकै कि ई सम्मेलन प्रभावी रूप स॑ चीन आरू पश्चिम के बीच काठमांडू केरऽ संतुलन बनाबै के काम के परीक्षा बनी गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ सरकार न॑ बीजिंग केरऽ चिंता क॑ कम करै के फैसला करलकै ।

आयोजक चीन स जुड़ल चिंता कए खारिज करैत छथि

आयोजक के तर्क छै कि ई सम्मेलन राजनीतिक सभा नै बल्कि शैक्षणिक आयोजन छेलै । ओ सब कहलनि जे, 2022 मे एकर आयोजन लेल नेपाल के चयन भेल अछि आ करीब 100 चीनी विद्वान आ विशेषज्ञ के सेहो उपस्थिति के उम्मीद अछि।

पेकिंग विश्वविद्यालय आरू चीन तिब्बत विज्ञान अनुसंधान केंद्र सहित चीनी संस्थानऽ के प्रतिभागी सिनी न॑ ई आयोजन लेली पंजीकरण करल॑ छेलै । आयोजक सब इहो कहलनि जे, सम्मेलन के उपयोग तिब्बत समर्थक या चीन विरोधी सक्रियता के लेल नहि होयत नेपाली अधिकारी के आश्वासन देलक अछि।

1979 म॑ ऑक्सफोर्ड विश्वविद्यालय म॑ स्थापित आईएटीएस खुद क॑ बिना राजनीतिक जुड़ाव के संगठन के रूप म॑ बतैलकै ।

विवाद संवेदनशील समय मे आबि रहल अछि। नेपाल में हजारों तिब्बती शरणार्थी के मेजबानी छै आरू तिब्बत के साथ एकरऽ लंबा समय स॑ सांस्कृतिक आरू धार्मिक संबंध छै, जबकि चीन भारत के बाद ओकरऽ दोसरऽ सबसें बड़ऽ व्यापारिक भागीदार छै ।

विज्ञापन

नेपाल के नाजुक संतुलन एक्ट

सम्मेलन विवाद नेपाल अपन दूटा पैघ पड़ोसी देशक बीच कठिन स्थिति पर प्रकाश दैत अछि ।

चीन लगातार अंतरराष्ट्रीय गतिविधि के विरोध करी रहलऽ छै जेकरा वू तिब्बत प॑ अपनऽ संप्रभुता क॑ चुनौती दै वाला मान॑ छै । ओतहि नेपाल भारत आ पाश्चात्य देशक संग अपन संबंधक प्रबंधन करैत बीजिंग सँ घनिष्ठ आर्थिक आ राजनीतिक संबंध बनौने रहबाक प्रयास केलक अछि ।

चीन केरऽ नया जातीय एकता कानून के खिलाफ तिब्बती लोगऽ के विरोध के बाद ई मुद्दा प॑ आरू संवेदनशीलता बढ़ी गेलऽ छै, जे १ जुलाई स॑ लागू होय गेलऽ छै ।

सम्मेलन के ऑनलाइन स्थानांतरित करला के बादो आयोजन स जुड़ल चीनी प्रतिनिधिमंडल के एखनहु एहि मास के अंत में नेपाल के दौरा करबाक उम्मीद अछि। चीनी राजनीतिक हस्ती जियांग जियांगुओ के नेतृत्व में पांच सदस्यीय प्रतिनिधिमंडल 18 अगस्त के तीन दिन के यात्रा पर पहुंचय वाला अछि.

काठमांडू स्थित चीनी दूतावास सम्मेलन निर्णय मे अपन कथित भूमिका के बारे मे पूछल गेल सवाल के सार्वजनिक रूप सं जवाब नहि देलक अछि.

title: Sher Bahadur Deuba's Return to Nepal Postponed to August 13 - Ratopati
description: Sher Bahadur Deuba's Return to Nepal Postponed to August 13  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article: Kathmandu. Nepali Congress leader Min Bishwakarma has said that the time of return of former president Sher Bahadur Deuba to Nepal has been changed. According to Bishwakarma, Deuba's return time has been set for 12 noon on August 13. Earlier, former spokesperson Dr. Prakash Sharan Mahat had said that Deuba, who was abroad for treatment, would return to Nepal on the night of August 11. Deuba had gone to Singapore from Nepal for treatment on February 13. After completing health check-ups and treatment in Singapore, he reached Hong Kong on March 23, 2024. After returning to Nepal, Deuba is scheduled to address a gathering called by the establishment- इतर group of the Nepali Congress. At a press conference held in Kathmandu on Friday, the convener of the gathering organizing committee, Dr. Shashank Koirala, had informed that Deuba would address the national gathering starting from August 14 in Kathmandu. Meanwhile, the Police Headquarters has stated that an investigation is underway regarding whether there are any legal cases or arrest warrants against him while Deuba is preparing to return home. At a press conference organized at the Police Headquarters on Friday, Police Spokesperson Abinarayan Kafle said that they are checking the records regarding whether there are any cases or arrest warrants against Deuba. When asked by journalists whether there is any basis to arrest or bring Deuba under investigation after he returns to the country, he replied, 'We are looking at the records regarding this. We will see what is there and proceed with the necessary action.'
translated: काठमांडू। नेपाली कांग्रेस नेता मिन विश्वकर्मा पूर्व अध्यक्ष शेरबहादुर देउबाके नेपाल घुरबाक समयमे परिवर्तन भेल बतौलनि अछि । विश्वकर्मा के अनुसार देउबा के वापसी के समय 13 अगस्त के दुपहर 12 बजे तय कायल गेल अछि, एहि सं पहिने पूर्व प्रवक्ता डॉ. प्रकाश शरण महत कहलखिन्ह जे इलाज के लेल विदेश मे आयल देउबा 13 फरवरी के राति मे नेपाल वापस आबि जेताह.देउबा 13 फरवरी के नेपाल सं सिंगापुर गेल छलीह २३, २०२४. शुक्रदिन काठमांडूमे आयोजित पत्रकार सम्मेलनमे सभा आयोजन समितिक संयोजक डा. शशांक कोइराला काठमाण्डौमे १४ अगस्तसँ शुरू भऽ रहल राष्ट्रिय सभामे देउवा सम्बोधन करएबाक सूचना देने छल । एम्हर, देउबा घर वापसी के तैयारी मे रहला पर हुनका पर कोनो कानूनी मामला या गिरफ्तारी वारंट अछि कि नहि, एहि संबंध मे जांच चलि रहल पुलिस मुख्यालय केने अछि। शुक्रदिन प्रहरी मुख्यालयमे आयोजित प्रेस कांफ्रेंसमे प्रहरी प्रवक्ता अबिनारायण काफ्ले देउबाके विरुद्ध कोनो मामला वा गिरफ्तारी वारंट अछि कि नहि, ताहि संबंधमे अभिलेखक जाँच कऽ रहल बतौलनि । पत्रकार सब स पूछला पर जे देउबा के देश वापस अयला के बाद गिरफ्तार करय या जांच के तहत लाबय के कोनो आधार अछि त ओ जवाब देलखिन्ह जे हम सब एहि संबंध मे रिकॉर्ड देख रहल छी. देखब जे की अछि आ आवश्यक काज आगू बढ़ब।'

title: Deuba’s return date to Nepal changed - Khabarhub
description: Deuba’s return date to Nepal changed  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Former Nepali Congress president Sher Bahadur Deuba’s return date to Nepal has been changed.

Deuba, who was previously scheduled to arrive in Kathmandu on the night of August 11, will now land at 12:30 pm on August 13, according to Nepali Congress leader Prakash Sharan Mahat.

Mahat said Deuba will arrive on a Thai Airways flight. The arrival time was changed as welcoming him at night would be difficult.

Deuba, who has been undergoing medical treatment in Singapore and Hong Kong, is also preparing to address the national gathering of the Nepali Congress establishment-opposition faction scheduled to begin in Kathmandu on August 14.

पहिने 11 अगस्त के राति मे काठमांडू पहुंचय वाला देउबा आब 13 अगस्त के राति 12:30 बजे उतरत नेपाली कांग्रेस नेता प्रकाशशरण महत के अनुसार।

महत कहला जे थाई एयरवेज क फ्लाइट स देउबा पहुंचत। राति मे स्वागत करब कठिन हेबाक कारणे आगमनक समय बदलि देल गेल ।

KATHMANDU: Seven Madhesh-focused political parties have jointly announced the formation of a new political alliance named the ‘Progressive Front’.

The alliance was announced at a programme held at Kathmandu Banquet in Thapagaun on Saturday. The participating parties include Janata Samajbadi Party Nepal, Janamat Party, Aam Janata Party, Pragatisheel Loktrantrik Party, Nagarik Unmukti Party Nepal, Nepal Sanghiya Samajbadi Party and Bahujan Ekta Party Nepal.

The Progressive Democratic Party, which includes former Maoist deputy general secretary Janardan Sharma and former Rastriya Swatantra Party leader Santosh Pariyar, is also part of the new front.

The formation comes amid ongoing efforts among Madhesh-based parties to strengthen political cooperation. With seven parties coming together, the new alliance is expected to have an impact on Nepal’s emerging political equations.

The front is preparing to move forward on the basis of shared political issues and common agendas.

title: How Beijing Just Flexed Its Diplomatic Muscle In Kathmandu – And Won - ETV Bharat
description: How Beijing Just Flexed Its Diplomatic Muscle In Kathmandu – And Won  ETV Bharat
publisher.title: ETV Bharat
full_article:
Kathmandu: Despite recent perceptions in China that the new youth-led government in Nepal might tilt towards the West and not China, the abrupt cancellation of an international meet on Tibetan studies proved otherwise.

That move illustrated that Kathmandu continues to remain responsive to Beijing’s sensitivities, especially when it comes to Tibetan issues, and that it doesn’t matter whether it’s cultural, religious, political or even academic matters.

Nepal shares its northern border, measuring some 1,450m, with the Tibetan Autonomous Region of China, and has been home to nearly 15,000 Tibetan refugees - who fled Tibet, alongside their spiritual leader the Dalai Lama, after the 1959 uprising.

That Kathmandu’s close ties with Beijing remain as intact became clear this week when Nepal’s Chief Secretary Govinda Bahadur Karkee requested the organiser of the Tibetan studies gathering, Kathmandu University (KU), to cancel the 17th International Association for Tibetan Studies (IATS) seminar, due to take place in Kathmandu from August 23 to 29.

It was expected to see a gathering of over 7,000 scholars of Tibetan and Buddhist studies from nearly 40 countries, including 159 from the United States and nearly 100 from China.

Karkee’s move followed last-minute Chinese concerns about the gathering, conveyed on July 21 to Nepal’s Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai by Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming.

China was particularly concerned about possible representation of delegates close to, or sympathetic to, the Tibetan exile administration based in Dharamsala, India, who, it feared, could have used the forum to criticise Beijing’s recent policies, including those currently being implemented in Tibet promoting national unity, reports said.

“We advised the organisers that it would be better not to hold the event,” a report in The Kathmandu Post quoted Chief Secretary Karkee as saying.

“It could be sensitive, several concerns might arise, and it could pose security risks. So we advised the organisers, in good faith, to cancel the event.”

The Post report noted that the sudden order to cancel the meet, which is said to have taken four years for the university to prepare, came despite clearance from Nepal’s Home Ministry and security officials who earlier said that the international conference would not throw up any security risks.

China is an important neighbour of Nepal.

On October 13 2019, visiting Chinese President Xi Jinping famously warned that “anyone attempting to split China will end in crushed bodies and shattered bones”.

title: Deuba reschedules return to Nepal for daytime airport reception - The Kathmandu Post
description: Deuba reschedules return to Nepal for daytime airport reception  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Former prime minister and former Nepali Congress president Sher Bahadur Deuba is returning to Nepal on August 13, ahead of a major gathering of his faction, with party cadres preparing to welcome him at Tribhuvan International Airport.

Deuba was initially scheduled to arrive in Kathmandu at 9:45 pm on August 11. He will now land at 12:25 pm on August 13 on a Thai Airways flight via Bangkok.

Congress leader Prakash Sharan Mahat said the late-night arrival was changed following requests from party leaders and workers who wanted to gather at the airport in large numbers to welcome Deuba.

Mahat said party loyalists planned to reach the airport well before midday. Former Central Working Committee chief secretary Krishna Paudel also confirmed Deuba’s revised travel itinerary.

Deuba left Nepal for Singapore on February 25 for medical treatment, missing voting in the House of Representatives election. His return comes after nearly five and a half months away from Nepal’s domestic political scene.

The revised schedule comes as Deuba’s faction in the Nepali Congress prepares to hold a national gathering in Kathmandu from August 14 to 16. The three-day gathering is expected to bring together party office-bearers, former ministers, lawmakers, local representatives and delegates from overseas diaspora organisations.

Deuba’s prolonged stay abroad came amid financial investigations by the Department of Money Laundering Investigation and the Central Investigation Bureau of Nepal Police. The investigations involve Deuba and his wife, former foreign minister Arzu Rana Deuba.

After the government issued arrest warrants against the couple in April, authorities approached Interpol seeking Red Notices. Interpol, however, rejected the request.

The couple subsequently filed legal petitions, following which the Supreme Court issued an interim order directing law enforcement agencies not to execute the arrest warrants on jurisdictional grounds concerning the Special Court.

In June, Deuba and Rana submitted written communications to the investigating authorities from abroad, saying they were away solely for medical treatment and had no intention of absconding.

According to the sources, Chinese officials, including Ambassador Zhang Maoming, held high-level meetings with Nepal’s Foreign Ministry and urged the Nepalese authorities to remain vigilant against discussions seen as supportive of Tibet or statements concerning the Dalai Lama.

The pressure intensified shortly before the decision to cancel the event, with visiting senior Chinese representatives also lobbying the Nepalese leadership in Kathmandu, the sources said.

Among them was Venerable Master Yinshun, a member of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference, who was in Nepal in the period leading up to the cancellation.

Security Clearance Overruled

Nepal’s internal security agencies had already cleared the conference after routine security vetting, according to the intelligence sources. However, the assessment of the domestic agencies was ultimately overruled following diplomatic and political pressure linked to Beijing.

Chief Secretary Govinda Bahadur Karkee, in consultation with Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai, personally instructed Kathmandu University to halt the conference, the sources said.

The decision was taken without the matter going through the Cabinet, according to the information available with CNN-News18 .

The episode is being viewed by Indian intelligence officials as a significant indication of Beijing’s growing influence within Nepal’s senior civil service and security establishment.

Beijing’s Concerns Over Tibet Discussions

China had raised concerns over the possibility that the conference could become a platform for discussions or statements on Tibet that went beyond academic scholarship, according to the sources.

The participation of Tibetan exile scholars was among the issues that caused unease within the Nepalese administration.

Officials were also concerned that public remarks during the seven-day event could turn the gathering into a platform for activist messaging on Tibet and the Dalai Lama, rather than remaining confined to academic discussions.

Nepal has long maintained a strict commitment to the One China principle and has avoided allowing activities on its territory that Beijing considers supportive of Tibetan separatism or anti-China political activity.

The prospect of more than 500 international scholars gathering in Kathmandu to discuss Tibetan history, culture and political questions was therefore seen by Nepalese officials as carrying the risk of friction with Beijing, the sources said.

There were also concerns within the administration that proceeding with the conference could affect Nepal’s wider bilateral relationship with China, including its trade and aid ties.

Venue Raised Monitoring Concerns

The scheduled venue, Hotel Soaltee in Kathmandu, also became a point of concern.

The hotel regularly hosts Chinese diplomatic delegations, raising security and privacy concerns over the possibility of participating scholars and delegates being monitored, according to the intelligence assessment.

Indian intelligence sources said the concerns have to be seen against what they described as an expanding Chinese intelligence infrastructure in Nepal aimed at tracking, profiling and restricting the movement of Tibetan refugees and international scholars.

The sources said such mechanisms are increasingly being used to closely watch Tibetan-linked activity inside Nepal, particularly events involving international participation or the possibility of politically sensitive discussions.

Part Of Wider Chinese Push In South Asia

Indian intelligence officials see the cancellation as part of a broader Chinese strategy to restrict Tibetan diaspora activities across South Asia.

Indian intelligence officials believe the trend could have wider implications for the regional balance, particularly given Nepal’s location along sensitive Himalayan border areas and its longstanding role as a transit and settlement point for sections of the Tibetan refugee community.

एहि मे चीनी जन राजनीतिक परामर्शदात्री सम्मेलन के सदस्य पूज्य मास्टर यिनशुन सेहो छलाह जे रद्द करय सं पहिने के अवधि मे नेपाल मे छलाह.

नेपाल मे अमेरिकी दूतावास यूएसवाईसी नेपाल कार्यक्रम के २०२६ के कोहोर्ट के लेल देश भर के १६०० स बेसी आवेदक स ५५ युवा नेता के चयन केलक अछि ।

संबंधित लेख रोहिंग्या शरणार्थी के साथ नाव पलटै के खबर के जांच करतें हुअय अधिकारी सिनी के तरफ स॑ ५०० स॑ भी अधिक के मौत के आशंका छै भारत म॑ वैश्विक अंतरिक्ष मिशन कार्यक्रम लेली चुनलऽ गेलऽ दू नेपाली किशोर

दूतावास न॑ शुक्रवार क॑ नयका कोहोर्ट लेली लॉन्चिंग सत्र के आयोजन करलकै, जेकरा म॑ चार्ज डी अफेयर्स स्कॉट उर्बम न॑ प्रतिभागी सिनी क॑ बधाई देलकै आरू अपनऽ समुदाय म॑ नवाचार, आर्थिक विकास आरू सकारात्मक परिवर्तन क॑ बढ़ावा दै म॑ हुनकऽ भूमिका प॑ जोर देलकै ।

अपनऽ एक साल के कार्यकाल के दौरान कोहोर्ट सदस्य नेतृत्व कौशल के विकास करतै, साथी आरू उद्योग विशेषज्ञऽ स॑ संबंध स्थापित करतै, आरू नेपाल के विकास म॑ योगदान दै के भविष्य के अवसर के तैयारी करतै ।
